content: Nystatin is an antifungal polyene antibiotic that is derived from the bacterium Streptomyces noursei. It is specifically formulated to combat fungal infections. Nystatin tablets are designed for oral administration and are provided as coated tablets, each containing 500,000 units of nystatin as the active ingredient. The tablets also include the following inactive ingredients: anhydrous lactose, carnauba wax, corn starch, FD&C Blue No. 2 Aluminum Lake, FD&C Red No. 40 Aluminum Lake, hydroxypropyl cellulose, hypromellose, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol, povidone, sodium starch glycolate, stearic acid, and titanium dioxide. These excipients are used to ensure the stability, efficacy, and proper delivery of the medication.
